# Baseline profile for the StreamDek TV app.
#
# Captured with `cmd package dump-profiles --dump-classes-and-methods com.streamdek.tv` after
# three cold launches through to Home. Captured on a phone rather than a television: a profile
# names code paths, not hardware, and the launch path is the same one either device walks.
#
# What it adds, and what was already there. A release build already shipped a baseline profile -
# but only what the AndroidX libraries contribute to it. Compose and androidx.tv were compiled
# ahead of time; the ~2,700 methods of this app's own code that run before Home appears were not.
#
# It matters more on a television than on a phone, and more here than in most apps. StreamDek
# installs from a downloaded APK rather than from a store, so there is no cloud profile to fill
# the gap; Android's own background dexopt only runs on idle and charging; and the boxes this
# runs on are the slowest hardware it will ever meet, so interpreting the launch path costs more
# here than anywhere else.
#
# AGP merges this with the libraries' profiles, rewrites the names through R8's mapping, and
# compiles the result into assets/dexopt/baseline.prof. It does not need recapturing when
# obfuscation changes - only when the launch path itself moves.
